known_limitations: Daily total-return levels are valuation proxies, not verified executable ETF quotes: the backtest is an execution-lagged, transaction-cost-adjusted historical simulation, not an executable trading reconstruction (Phase 6 contract limitation).
Transaction costs are an illustrative uniform 10 bp one-way estimate; no market impact, no bid/ask, no volume data; the small price-taking portfolio assumption is not validated.
Historical Phase 4 macro inputs behind the Phase 5 posterior are latest-revised series: complete point-in-time validity is not claimed.

83 monthly holding periods (about seven years): realized-performance inference has limited power; several comparisons are reported (multiple-comparison caveat); statistical significance is not causality and a single-factor beta regression does not identify skill.

The methodology of Phases 1-6 was developed on the same history (in-sample methodological development); the backtest is not an out-of-sample forecast test and past outperformance is not evidence of future performance.

Persistent exposures (Equity, Gold, Convertibles overweights; Government Bonds underweight) mean part of the active return is a systematic-exposure effect; the ex-post average-weight decomposition is descriptive and uses future information.

Executed trades restore the target weights at every execution date (targets achieved at the close), so even dates with no planned Phase 6 trade carry a small drift-correcting trade; planned and executed no-trade counts therefore differ by construction.
The cash leg (EONIA->ESTR) is an overnight rate, not a deposit actually earned; it enters only the Sharpe / Sortino / alpha statistics.

metric_definitions.total_return: NAV_T / NAV_0 - 1 (daily post-trade NAV, deployment close to the last execution close)
metric_definitions.arithmetic_annual_return: 12 x mean monthly holding-period net return
metric_definitions.annualized_volatility: sqrt(12) x std(monthly net return, ddof = 1); daily variant sqrt(252) x std(daily return)
metric_definitions.max_drawdown: min_u NAV_u / max_{s<=u} NAV_s - 1 on the daily post-trade NAV; duration peak -> recovery (or window end), calendar days
metric_definitions.sharpe_excess_over_cash: sqrt(12) x mean(R - c) / std(R - c, ddof = 1); c = realized ACT/360 EONIA->ESTR cash return over the same holding period
metric_definitions.return_to_volatility_zero_rate: sqrt(12) x mean(R) / std(R): a zero-rate convention, NOT a Sharpe ratio
metric_definitions.var_monthly_q / expected_shortfall_month: historical: -quantile_{1-q}(R) and -mean(R | R <= quantile); daily variants on daily returns
metric_definitions.tracking_error_realized: sqrt(12) x std(R - R_B, ddof = 1) against the strategic GMP rebalanced strategy (S2) -- realized, never the Phase 6 ex-ante TE
metric_definitions.information_ratio: 12 x mean(R - R_B) / realized tracking error
metric_definitions.beta_to_benchmark / correlation_with_ben: OLS slope of (R - c) on (R_B - c); Pearson correlation of R and R_B
metric_definitions.alpha_annualized: 12 x intercept of (R - c) = alpha + beta (R_B - c) + e with Newey-West HAC standard errors (diagnostics/regressions.csv)
metric_definitions.mean_monthly_turnover / annual_turnover: 0.5 sum_i |w_i - w_pre_i| per rebalance (target-weight convention), mean over rebalance dates; annual = 12 x mean
metric_definitions.total_traded_notional_over_nav: sum over executions of sum_i |delta_i| with delta the exact executed notionals as fractions of pre-trade NAV
metric_definitions.rebalancing_events_with_trades / no_trad: execution dates after the deployment with (without) any |trade| > 1e-12 (executed trades restore targets, so planned Phase 6 no-trade months carry a small drift-correcting trade)
metric_definitions.holding_persistence: mean over rebalance dates of 1 - turnover (fraction of the portfolio carried over unchanged)
